description:
1666: Amsterdam has officially entered Early Access and Panache Digital Games shared a brand-new gameplay trailer to get players excited.

Every 333 years, something stirs, and players will discover exactly what that is in this third-person dark, story-led, action-adventure game. 

Players will become Noa, the Collector, who wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate during the day, and face your demons when the sun goes down.

Fans can relive the Battle of Earth with new scenes leading up to Avengers: Doomsday in Avengers Endgame: Encore, in theaters on September 25.

Witness the battle of a lifetime as the Avengers pick up the pieces of Infinity War, embark on a grand time heist, and make a heartfelt sacrifice that rippled through all of humanity. Assemble once more in the re-release of Avengers Endgame with Avengers Endgame: Encore.

Avengers Endgame: Encore stars Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Mark Ruffalo, Chris Hemsworth, Josh Brolin, Scarlett Johansson, and more. The film is directed Anthony and Joe Russo alongside being written by Christopher Markus, Stephen McFeely, and Stan Lee.

Avengers Endgame: Encore is in theaters on September 25.

description:
Don't miss the Official Trailer for Ali G: Who Iz I?, an upcoming documentary-style comedy film distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Explore the hilarity, trials, and tribulations of Ali G in Ali G: Who Iz I?, in theaters on October 23.

After twenty years spent “chillin’, tokin’ and bonin’”, Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child’s very existence. 

Ali G: Who Iz I? stars Sacha Baron Cohen and Morgana Robinson. The film is written and directed by the one and onlycSacha Baron Cohen.

Ali G in Ali G: Who Iz I? is in theaters on October 23.

description:
Nick Salazar from the PR team at The Pokemon Company International paid a visit to the NVC crew this week to talk about Pokemon’s big upcoming weekend. The Pokemon World Championships are happening August 28-30 in San Francisco, alongside Pokemon XP, which is the first-ever official fan convention centered around Pokemon. Logan and Casey ask Nick about how the event came together, what fans can expect, Pokemon Champions’ role in the franchise moving forward, and if we can expect a tease surrounding the future of Pokemon at this weekend’s events.

#Pokemon #pokemonxp #nintendo
title: The Future of Live Pokemon Fan Events and Tournaments with The Pokemon Company - NVC Clips
